by: claude: Switzerland income and inheritance tax per canton, 2024-2026
note: Income tax and inheritance tax are cantonal and communal in Switzerland, so they become regional taxes, each canton valued at its capital (as for the wealth tax): computed with the federal tax administration's own calculator (ESTV) for tax years 2024, 2025 and 2026. Single person, no church tax; inheritance for a child and for an unrelated heir. The federal income tax (top 11.5%) stays on the national row. The cantonal tax on gains from selling real estate has no ESTV calculator, so it stays a gap.

jurisdictions.structure_note: Cantonal and communal (26 cantons; each commune applies its own multiplier): the net wealth tax, the income tax (on top of the federal income tax) and the inheritance tax. One region per canton, valued at its capital. Capital gains on private shares are exempt everywhere; the tax on real estate gains is cantonal (not yet stored); there is no federal wealth or inheritance tax.
